feedback.Physical Object: Included — A tangible, discrete unit with defined boundaries.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — Fully manufactured with industrial and electronic components.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — No biological origin or inspiration.
feedback.Powered: Included — Operates using batteries or USB power.
feedback.Structural: Included — Internal sensor and circuitry organized within a housing.
feedback.Observable: Included — Form and interface (display, light, or buttons) are visible.
feedback.Physical Medium: Included — Composed of plastic, metal, and circuit materials.
feedback.Active: Included — Continuously samples input, processes data, and may issue output.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Engineered to measure and report temperature readings.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Included — Communicates measurements via signal, display, or app.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Converts physical input into structured output via digital logic.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Switches between active states (idle, sensing, transmitting).
feedback.Human-Interactive: Included — Designed for user setup, reading, and feedback.
feedback.System-integrated: Included — Often part of smart home or medical monitoring systems.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Included — Can operate independently once configured.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Typically optional or interchangeable in its system.
feedback.Symbolic: Excluded — Does not represent or stand for anything beyond its direct function; not a symbolic object.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Communicates structured data such as current or logged temperature.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Operates based on programmed logic (e.g., thresholds, alerts).
feedback.Compositional: Excluded — Not meaningfully modular in abstract system terms.
feedback.Normative: Excluded — Does not enforce rules or guide social behavior.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Measures and reports over time; sequences are time-sensitive.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Operates entirely on digital/firmware-based logic.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Defined physically and functionally, not symbolically.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Excluded — Not classified by institutional authority.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not linked to individual or group identity.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Often subject to data, safety, and medical device regulations.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Significant player in health, consumer, and IoT device markets.
feedback.Politicised: Excluded — Not ideologically debated or regulated by public controversy.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Raises issues related to privacy, surveillance, and medical data reliability.

encoding_notes: This encoding treats the smart thermometer as a digitally powered sensing device with meaningful autonomy, real-time signaling, and ethical/regulatory relevance. Final UHT code: DFFE6319.
